original_paper_innovations.description: First to identify that DiT attention sparsity follows hierarchical blockified structure rather than continuous patterns
original_paper_innovations.runtime_change: From continuous pattern search [L, d, L] to block-wise pattern [(1-sparsity)L, d, L] with B=64

original_paper_innovations.description: Exploits step-invariance property to cache LSE across denoising steps, enabling precise online search
original_paper_innovations.runtime_change: From O(L²d) full search every step to O(L²d/B²) search at steps {10,30} plus O((1-sparsity)L²d) sparse attention
original_paper_innovations.impact: Reduces search overhead to <5% of total time

original_paper_innovations.description: Dynamically adjusts sparsity per attention head based on recall performance while maintaining average sparsity
original_paper_innovations.runtime_change: No additional runtime cost, improves quality by +0.56 PSNR over uniform sparsity
original_paper_innovations.impact: Maintains quality while achieving target sparsity

original_paper_innovations.description: Plug-and-play implementation requiring no fine-tuning or dataset profiling
original_paper_innovations.runtime_change: Zero training time, single line code change
original_paper_innovations.impact: Immediate deployment across different DiT models

identified_gaps.description: Method only addresses 3D unified attention, doesn't optimize spatial-temporal separated attention
identified_gaps.current_limitation: Cannot be applied to older DiT architectures using separate spatial/temporal attention

identified_gaps.description: Uses static block size (64) regardless of video resolution or sequence characteristics
identified_gaps.current_limitation: Suboptimal for varying video resolutions (480p vs 4K)

identified_gaps.description: Search steps {10,30} are manually chosen without adaptive mechanism
identified_gaps.current_limitation: May not be optimal for all video lengths and content types

identified_gaps.description: Experiments limited to single A100 GPU, no multi-GPU optimization
identified_gaps.current_limitation: Doesn't leverage distributed computing for longer videos

identified_gaps.description: Sparse patterns don't explicitly enforce temporal consistency between frames
identified_gaps.current_limitation: Potential for temporal artifacts in long sequences

proposed_improvements.description: Dynamically adjust block size based on video resolution and sequence length
proposed_improvements.method: B = min(max(32, sqrt(h*w)/4), 128) where h×w is frame resolution
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From fixed [L/64, 64², L/64] to adaptive [L/B, B², L/B] with B∈[32,128]
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: 5-10% additional speedup for 4K videos, better cache locality

proposed_improvements.description: Use hierarchical block sizes (coarse-to-fine) to capture multi-scale dependencies
proposed_improvements.method: Combine B={32,64,128} blocks with learned importance weights
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From single-scale [(1-sparsity)L, d, L] to multi-scale Σ_i[(1-sparsity_i)L, d, L] with Σsparsity_i=target
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: Improved recall by 3-5%, better handling of multi-scale video content

proposed_improvements.description: Adapt search frequency based on pattern stability metrics
proposed_improvements.method: Monitor LSE variance across steps; increase search frequency when variance > threshold
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From fixed {10,30} searches to adaptive scheduling with O(L²d/B²) searches only when needed
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: Reduce search overhead by 20-30% for stable content

proposed_improvements.description: Enforce smooth temporal transitions in sparse patterns across frames
proposed_improvements.method: Add temporal smoothness term: λ||M_t - M_{t-1}||_F to block selection objective
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: Minimal overhead: O(L²d/B²) for temporal regularization computation
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: Reduce temporal flickering artifacts, improve video coherence

proposed_improvements.description: Distribute attention computation across multiple GPUs with block-wise partitioning
proposed_improvements.method: Split video frames across GPUs, use ring communication for cross-frame attention
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From [L, d, L] on single GPU to [L/GPUs, d, L] per GPU + communication overhead
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: Near-linear scaling: 3.5× speedup with 4 GPUs for 24s videos

proposed_improvements.description: Adjust target sparsity based on video content complexity
proposed_improvements.method: Use frame difference analysis to set sparsity = base_sparsity × (1 - motion_complexity)
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: O(hw) complexity for motion analysis, negligible compared to attention
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: Maintain quality for high-motion content while maximizing speedup for static scenes

proposed_improvements.description: Use lightweight neural network to refine block patterns based on local features
proposed_improvements.method: Small MLP predicts block importance scores from query/key statistics
proposed_improvements.runtime_change: From [(1-sparsity)L, d, L] to [(1-sparsity+α)L, d, L] with α=0.05 learnable refinement
proposed_improvements.expected_benefit: 2-3% quality improvement with minimal speed impact

improved_adaspa.matrix_multiplication: [(1-0.75)L, d, L] average + [L/B, B², L/B] adaptive search

experimental_parameters.datasets: VBench with prompt optimization for CogVideoX1.5
